objections: The three words are not honoured equally: at every stage capable sits on 35 to 45 of the 48 lines and about half carry it alone, while kind sits on 11 to 16 and is nearly absent from four of the eight capabilities, so my child's report will be an academic report with a thin kindness column.

Many counter-examples are written as if no parent will read them ('grabs or hits', 'to get them in trouble', 'hands in AI-assisted work as fully their own', 'refuses to argue a side they do not hold'): portraits of a bad child rather than the near-miss an educator honestly confuses.

Four lines make the school the keeper of what is not its to keep: a four-year-old's recorded words about their feelings, 'a personal difficulty', another child's 'serious difficulty', and a habit at home, while 'didi' assumes what kind of home my child comes from.
note_to_founders: I read all 192 and understood nearly every one at first sight, which is more than I can say for most school documents, and I would sign most of them into my child's file as they stand. Three things before your own pass. First, the three words are not equal here: at every stage capable sits on 35 to 45 of the 48 lines and about half carry it alone, while kind sits on 11 to 16 and is nearly absent from Knowledge, Thinking, Learning and Creation, so the report you send me will be a strong academic report with a thin column for the child you say you are raising; either add kind and unafraid lines to those capabilities (I have offered six) or tell parents plainly that those two words are evidenced mainly in two areas. Second, the counter-examples read as if no parent will ever see them, and we will: 'grabs or hits', 'to get them in trouble', 'hands in AI-assisted work as fully their own', 'refuses to argue a side they do not hold' are portraits of a bad child, not the near-miss an educator honestly confuses, and I have rewritten the ones that read as accusations. Third, keep the file to what happened at school: do not record my four-year-old's words about their feelings in their own voice, do not file 'a personal difficulty' or 'a peer's serious difficulty' as routine evidence, do not reach into home habits, and do not assume every child comes with a didi. Two smaller things: parent_voice is never used, so nothing I see at home counts, which I can accept but you should say is a choice; and a handful of words (register, limiting case, unplugged, library) need their plain version in whatever the parent reads.
